what: Edzői kezdőlap — A kód elkészült: the sheet that shows a freshly minted join code once.
why: Minting a code is a write the UI cannot undo (a code can be revoked, never deleted), so no capture mints one. The POST is answered here.
how: POST /invite-codes answers 201 { id, code } (backend/src/coaching/routes.js:250); the code string is the one the frame draws. The list behind the sheet is the recorded one: the new row the frame shows first is NOT added (that needs an inserted row, which pulse-fixture-check cannot judge yet — request R-F3-01).
open: pulse-fixture-check refuses a 2xx body for an endpoint that was never recorded. This sheet cannot exist without the code string, and a code is never minted live: the ruling is the integrator's (R-F3-01).
